name: Treating Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to a Christ-centered ethic of treating others with love and humility, reflecting the command to love our neighbors as ourselves and to do to others what we desire done to us. Jesus contrasts the old teaching of hating enemies with a higher standard of love and kindness toward all, while Paul urges humility by esteeming others above ourselves. James warns against favoritism within the community, emphasizing equal respect regardless of social status, thereby underscoring the biblical mandate to honor every person as made in God's image.
